name: Monitor.Cat
author: monitorcat

sections.description:
Monitor.Cat is a modular WordPress operations plugin that puts backups, security, mail delivery, performance optimization, and remote management in one place — without bloating your site with five separate plugins.

Why Monitor.Cat?

Every module is independent. Enable only what you need, disable the rest. Zero overhead from features you don’t use.

Modules

  • Backup — Scheduled and on-demand database and file backups with chunked processing for large sites.
  • Security — Login hardening, file integrity checks, and risk diagnostics.
  • SMTP / Mail Bridge — Send WordPress emails through SMTP or provider APIs (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark) with one-click configuration.
  • Scanner — Detect modified core files, suspicious code patterns, and malware signatures.
  • WebP — Automatic image conversion to WebP format for faster page loads.
  • Redirect — Manage 301/302 URL redirects from the WordPress admin.
  • Privacy — Consent logging and privacy compliance tools.
  • Remote API — Securely connect to the Monitor.Cat dashboard for centralized multi-site management with HMAC-signed communication.
  • Logger — Centralized operational logs with configurable retention.
  • Info — System diagnostics and environment health checks (PHP, memory, cron status).

Presets

Get started fast with built-in configuration presets for common setups: company sites, WooCommerce stores, and agency-managed sites.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

Monitor.Cat Platform (app.monitor.cat)

When the Remote module is enabled, this plugin communicates with the Monitor.Cat SaaS platform at https://app.monitor.cat. This connection is used for:

  • Pairing flow: When you click “Request Pairing Code” in the Setup Wizard, your site URL, site name, and admin email are sent to app.monitor.cat/wp-connect to initiate the connection.
  • Status sync: When you click “Sync Status” on the Remote module page, the plugin calls app.monitor.cat/api/v1/plugin/connect/{session}/status to retrieve your connection status.
  • Remote commands: Once paired, the Monitor.Cat dashboard can send authenticated (HMAC-signed) commands to your site’s REST API to trigger backups, scans, and other operations.

No data is sent to Monitor.Cat until you explicitly initiate a connection through the Setup Wizard or Remote module settings.

Service website: https://app.monitor.cat
Corporate website: https://monitor.top
Terms of Service: https://monitor.top/terms
Privacy Policy: https://monitor.top/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install from the WordPress Plugin Directory (Plugins > Add New > search “Monitor.Cat”), or upload the monitor-cat folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Monitor.Cat > Setup Wizard to choose a preset and enable your modules.
sections.faq:
What PHP version is required?

PHP 8.0 or higher is required.

What modules are included?

Ten modules: Backup, Security, SMTP / Mail Bridge, Scanner, WebP, Redirect, Privacy, Remote API, Logger, and Info. Each can be enabled or disabled independently.

Do I have to use all the modules?

No. Every module is optional. Enable only what you need — disabled modules have zero performance impact.

Does this plugin send data to external servers?

Only when you explicitly enable and configure the Remote module. See the External Services section above for full details. No data is sent until you initiate a connection.

Is it free?

The plugin is free and open source (GPLv2). The optional Monitor.Cat dashboard provides centralized multi-site management.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Monitor.Cat includes a WooCommerce preset that pre-configures the most useful modules for online stores.
